notes.subject: בעבור
notes.rationale: 'on account of / so that' — purposive reading 'that they might keep', rendered as 'bihain long olsem, ol i ken'

notes.subject: ישמרו / ינצרו
notes.rationale: two near-synonymous 'keep/guard' verbs in parallel, chiastic order statutes–laws / keep–observe

notes.subject: הללו יה
notes.rationale: imperative 'Praise Ya!' summons the congregation, closing the psalm

translation: Bihain long olsem, ol i ken bihainim ⟨את⟩ ol statut bilong em, na ol i ken lukautim ⟨את⟩ ol Tora bilong em. Singautim nem bilong Ya!

tokens.gloss: bihain long olsem, ol i ken
